method.population: Actual generator, models, navigation, resources and scheduling. Only stress population slider limits lifted. No actors cloned and no clearance checks disabled.
method.largeFixture: 40 base animals plus 12 actual paddock placement commits, 80 animals each, 13 tiles. This has placement/access warnings and a reproducible expansion ledger offset; not a validated settlement.
method.rate: Elapsed fixed-clock simulation seconds divided by wall seconds; 1.0 means intended speed. Pending time is retained, not dropped.
method.moved: Animals whose authoritative positions differ by more than 1 cm between sample endpoints. This does not mean all move simultaneously.
method.collisions: Endpoint checks plus existing UI-cadence checks where sampledMaxCollisions is present. Not a continuous swept-collision proof.
method.phone: 390x844 desktop Chrome viewport; not a physical-phone benchmark.
method.variance: Sequential short samples on a shared workstation. Single observations except identified repeat/soak; no causal speedup claim.
